title: MLA Charge-Inclusion Classifier
description: Closed-set lookup of whether a charge type must be included in the Military Lending Act MAPR under 32 CFR 232.4(c) and 232.4(d). Returns included_in_mapr as true, false or conditional, the exact paragraph cited, a plain basis sentence, the named participation-fee figure where the regulation states one, and an explicit manual-review flag on the single cell a closed-set lookup cannot resolve. The declared domain is 9 charge types x is_credit_card_account x short_term_exception_claimed = 36 states, all enumerated. Three charge types return conditional rather than a boolean because the regulation's own worked examples at 232.4(d)(4)(iii) run the same fee twice and reach opposite answers on facts a charge type cannot express. The 232.4(c)(1)(iii)(B) short-term carve-out sets manual_review_required and names its three missing predicates instead of guessing. conditional_limit_usd reports the $100 per annum figure of 232.4(c)(2)(ii)(B) on the participation-fee credit-card cells: it names that figure and never compares it to an amount, since 232.4(c)(2)(ii)(B) withdraws the limit for a bona fide participation fee under paragraph (d) and 232.4(d)(3)(iv) offers a $400 fee as potentially reasonable. Performs no arithmetic: no ratio, no scale, no threshold compare, no rounding. Does not determine covered-borrower status, does not compute a MAPR, does not compare anything to the 36 percent limit of 232.4(b), and does not decide whether a fee is bona fide or reasonable under 232.4(d)(1) and 232.4(d)(3).

charge_type.description: One of nine closed enum values: credit_insurance_premium, single_premium_credit_insurance_charge, debt_cancellation_fee, debt_suspension_fee, credit_related_ancillary_product_fee, finance_charge, application_fee, participation_fee, other_credit_card_fee. Mandatory. A value outside this set is outside the declared domain and outside the enumeration claim.

is_credit_card_account.description: True means consumer credit extended in a credit card account under an open-end, not home-secured, plan. That is the exact predicate 232.4(d)(1) opens on, and it is the only input that turns the bona fide fee exclusion on. Default false.

short_term_exception_claimed.description: True asserts reliance on the 232.4(c)(1)(iii)(B) short-term small amount loan carve-out. Semantically meaningful only for charge_type application_fee and a no-op for the other eight, though the enumeration still varies it across all nine so the coverage claim is not a filtered one. Default false.

mcp_tool_definition.name: classify_mla_charge_inclusion
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classifies whether a given charge type must be included in the Military Lending Act MAPR under 32 CFR 232.4(c) and 232.4(d). Returns included_in_mapr as true, false or conditional, the exact paragraph cited, a plain basis sentence, conditional_limit_usd where the regulation names a figure, and manual_review_required with a reason on the one cell the closed set cannot resolve. Performs no arithmetic and computes no MAPR.
